falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price breaks above the 200-day moving average by more than 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish trend would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal, as it contradicts the pattern's implied bearish or stagnant trajectory.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume surges to 200% above the 30-day average volume within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would indicate a breakout or reversal, falsifying the 'HOLD' by showing active price momentum against the current pattern.

falsification_conditions.condition: The Blowoff Score increases to 70 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff top scenario would directly contradict the current 'HOLD' signal, as it implies an imminent reversal rather than continuation of the existing pattern.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
